bio.en: CS undergrad at SCUT researching LLM unlearning while building multi-agent, quant and full-stack systems. Also a class monitor, Flag Guard propagandist and industry intern connecting research with real deployments.

title.zh: 基于 Hessian 矩阵的 LLM 机器遗忘学习
title.en: LLM Machine Unlearning via Hessian Curvature

tagline.zh: 让大模型「精确遗忘」指定知识，同时保住通用能力
tagline.en: Precisely erase target knowledge from LLMs without breaking general ability

summary.zh: 提出基于二阶曲率信息的遗忘算子，对参数局部线性近似下的影响函数做加速近似，达到数倍于现有方法的遗忘效率，同时保留下游任务表现。
summary.en: Proposes a second-order influence-function approximation that erases targeted samples from a fine-tuned LLM with multiple-x speedup over baselines, while retaining downstream performance.

highlights.zh: 相比 Gradient Ascent 基线提速 4-6 倍
在 7B / 13B 两个量级 LLM 上完成可复现实验
保留下游 MMLU 平均得分回退 < 1%

title.zh: LangGraph 多智能体协同架构

tagline.zh: 把规划、检索、写作、评审拆成可路由的图节点

summary.zh: 基于 LangGraph 设计可热插拔的智能体协同框架，支持任务路由、子图回滚、流式输出，已在多个真实业务场景落地。
summary.en: A pluggable multi-agent framework on LangGraph with task routing, subgraph rollback and streaming output, deployed in multiple real-world use cases.

highlights.zh: 可热插拔的子图节点，新增能力 < 1 天
highlights.en: Hot-pluggable subgraph nodes; add a capability in < 1 day

highlights.zh: 内置评审环节，端到端事实正确率提升 23%
